banner.title: cliproxyapi
banner.tagline: Turns subscription OAuth logins into an OpenAI-compatible API that LiteLLM routes to.

explainer.title: Subscription logins behind one API key

steps.title: Seed
steps.text: An init container copies the OAuth files from Secret cliproxyapi-seed onto the PVC, only when a file of that name is missing.
steps.scene: a sealed JSON file dropped into a vault

steps.title: Config
steps.text: Secret cliproxyapi-config renders config.yaml with the client keys and the management key, mounted read-only at /config.
steps.scene: a gated panel with two keyholes

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: The app listens on port 8317. HTTPRoute cliproxyapi on envoy-internal is the only way in, and LiteLLM is the main caller.
steps.scene: a single data plug feeding a router

steps.title: Refresh
steps.text: The app rewrites refreshed tokens into /data/auths on the 1 Gi ceph-block claim. After the first seed the Secret never overwrites them.
steps.scene: a token rotating inside a ring

steps.title: Back up
steps.text: Kopiur snapshots the claim to the local Ceph pool every few hours and to R2 once a day, so a lost volume restores the logins.
steps.scene: a stack of snapshot cards on a shelf
